def max_non_palindrome_substring(s):
    n = len(s)
    dp = [[False] * n for _ in range(n)]
    max_length = 0
    
    for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
        for j in range(i, n):
            if i == j:
                dp[i][j] = True
            elif i + 1 == j:
                dp[i][j] = s[i] != s[j]
            else:
                dp[i][j] = s[i] == s[j] and dp[i+1][j-1]
            
            if dp[i][j]:
                continue
            
            max_length = max(max_length, j - i + 1)
    
    return max_length

def max_non_palindrome_substring(s):
    n = len(s)
    max_length = 0
    
    def is_palindrome(sub):
        return sub == sub[::-1]
    
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):
            substring = s[i:j]
            if not is_palindrome(substring):
                max_length = max(max_length, len(substring))
                
    return max_length

def max_non_palindrome_substring(s):
    n = len(s)
    max_length = 0
    non_palindromes = set()
    
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):
            substring = s[i:j]
            if substring != substring[::-1]:
                non_palindromes.add(substring)
                max_length = max(max_length, len(substring))
                
    return max_length
